comments.body:
Comes from new recipe that appears after you report Lighthouse of Alexandria (need to reach the deepest part of Sea of Wonders) from Ibn in Alexandria.

Recipe Name : Hyper Volkan (18)
Skill Reqs : Casting Rank 15
Ingredients : Volkan (8) + 5x Strange Cannon + Set of Repair Tools

Stats :
70/70 Durability
Maximum PP points (according to JP wiki) 1350
Range 490
Speed 7
Burst 7
Reload 4
